title: A finite free module is finitely presented and flat
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $P$ an $A$-module that is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with a finite basis. Then $P$ is finitely presented [def-sc-finitely-presented-module] and flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
